I heard Cole-san's feeling a little
better.

rows.label: tlk43200141_05_msg0002
rows.name: That's thanks to you all, right?

rows.label: tlk43200141_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Ion-chan's feeling better, and my
dream of standing on this stage
survived too...

rows.label: tlk43200141_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Watching The Life of Hero Adel can
make Blades seem scary, but they're
actually very kind.

rows.label: tlk43200141_05_msg0006
rows.name:
When I play one someday, I won't make
Blades too scary. I'll show their
mercy and tolerance too.
